sql_query:
SELECT *
FROM object
INNER JOIN probability ON object.oid = probability.oid
WHERE probability.ranking = 1  -- Only the most likely classification
  AND probability.classifier_name = 'stamp_classifier'  -- Filter by stamp classifier
  AND probability.class_name = 'SN'  -- Classified as SN
  AND object.firstmjd >= 60173.0  -- First detection on or after August 17
  AND object.firstmjd <= 60177.0  -- First detection on or before August 21
  AND (probability.probability > 0.5 OR object.ndet >= 2)  -- Probability > 0.5 or at least 2 detections

['
CREATE TABLE object ( /* this is the most important table. It contains the main statistics of an object, independent of time and band */
    oid VARCHAR PRIMARY KEY,  /* object identifier, from the ZTF */
    deltajd DOUBLE PRECISION, /* time difference between last and first detection */
    firstmjd DOUBLE PRECISION, /* time of first detection */
    lastmjd DOUBLE PRECISION, /* time of last detection */
    ndethist INTEGER,  /* number of posible detections above 3 sigma */
    ncovhist INTEGER,  /* number of visits */
    mjdstarthist DOUBLE PRECISION,  /* time of first observation even if not detected, Earliest Julian date of epoch corresponding to ndethist [days]*/
    mjdendhist DOUBLE PRECISION, /* time of last observation even if not detected, Latest Julian date of epoch corresponding to ndethist [days] */
    corrected BOOLEAN, /* whether the object was corrected */
    stellar BOOLEAN, /* whether the object is likely psf shaped */
    ndet INTEGER, /* total number of detections for the object */
    g_r_max DOUBLE PRECISION, /* g-r difference color at maximum */
    g_r_max_corr DOUBLE PRECISION, /* g-r color at maximum*/
    g_r_mean DOUBLE PRECISION, /* mean g-r difference color */
    g_r_mean_corr DOUBLE PRECISION, /* mean g-r color */
    meanra DOUBLE PRECISION,  /* mean right ascension */
    meandec DOUBLE PRECISION,  /* mean declination */
    sigmara DOUBLE PRECISION, /* right ascension dispersion */
    sigmadec DOUBLE PRECISION, /* declination dispersion */
    step_id_corr VARCHAR, /* correction step pipeline version */
    diffpos BOOLEAN, /* whether the first detection was positive or negative */
    reference_change BOOLEAN /* whether the reference image changes */
);

CREATE INDEX ix_object_g_r_mean_corr ON object USING btree (g_r_mean_corr);
CREATE INDEX ix_object_meanra ON object USING btree (meanra);
CREATE INDEX ix_object_meandec ON object USING btree (meandec);
', 'CREATE TABLE probability ( /* this table contains the machine learning derived classification probabilities and rankings */

    class_name VARCHAR, /* name of the class */

    classifier_version VARCHAR, /* version of the classiifer */
    probability DOUBLE PRECISION NOT NULL, /* probability of the class given a classifier and version */
    ranking INTEGER NOT NULL, /* class probability ranking (1 is the most likely class) */

    oid VARCHAR REFERENCES object(oid), /* unique object identifier */
    mjd DOUBLE PRECISION NOT NULL, /* time of detection in modified julian date */
    fid INTEGER NOT NULL, /* filter identifier  (1=g; 2=r; 3=i)*/
    pid FLOAT NOT NULL, /* program identifier */
    diffmaglim DOUBLE PRECISION, /* limiting difference magnitud */
    isdiffpos INTEGER NOT NULL, /* whether the difference is positive or negative */
    nid INTEGER, /* unique night identifier */

    dec DOUBLE PRECISION NOT NULL, /* inferred declination */
    magpsf DOUBLE PRECISION NOT NULL, /* point spread function (psf) difference magnitude */
    sigmapsf DOUBLE PRECISION NOT NULL, /* psf difference magnitude error */
    magap DOUBLE PRECISION, /* aperture difference magnitude */
    sigmagap DOUBLE PRECISION, /* aperture difference magnitud error */

    magpsf_corr DOUBLE PRECISION, /* apparent magnitude (corrected difference magnitude) */
    sigmapsf_corr DOUBLE PRECISION, /* error of the apparent magnitude assuming point like source */
    sigmapsf_corr_ext DOUBLE PRECISION, /* error of the apparent magnitude assuming extended source */

      AND f.fid = 2

no_variability_or_detections_g_band AS (
    -- Subquery for no variability in the g band
    SELECT DISTINCT f.oid
    FROM feature f
    INNER JOIN agn_objects ao ON f.oid = ao.oid
    WHERE f.name = 'ExcessVar'
      AND f.fid = 1
      AND f.value = 0

    UNION

    -- Subquery for no detections in the g band
    SELECT DISTINCT m.oid
    FROM magstat m
    INNER JOIN agn_objects ao ON m.oid = ao.oid
    WHERE m.fid = 1
      AND m.ndet = 0
),

    SELECT oid
    FROM variability_r_band
    INTERSECT
    SELECT oid
    FROM no_variability_or_detections_g_band
)

FROM feature f
INNER JOIN filtered_objects fo ON f.oid = fo.oid

-- Step 1: Filter objects classified as AGN
WITH agn_objects AS (
    SELECT oid
    FROM probability
    WHERE class_name = 'AGN'
      AND classifier_name = 'lc_classifier'
      AND ranking = 1
),

-- Step 2: Identify objects showing variability in the r band
r_band_variability AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT f.oid
    FROM feature f
    INNER JOIN agn_objects ao ON f.oid = ao.oid
    WHERE f.fid = 2 -- r band
      AND f.name IN ('ExcessVar', 'Eta_e') -- Variability-related features
      AND f.value IS NOT NULL
),

-- Step 3: Identify objects with no detections or no variability in the g band
g_band_no_detections_or_variability AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT f.oid
    FROM feature f
    INNER JOIN agn_objects ao ON f.oid = ao.oid
    WHERE f.fid = 1 -- g band
      AND (
          f.name = 'n_det' AND f.value = 0 -- No detections
          OR f.name IN ('ExcessVar', 'Eta_e') AND f.value IS NULL -- No variability
      )
),

-- Step 4: Combine results from Steps 2 and 3
filtered_objects AS (
    SELECT oid
    FROM r_band_variability
    INTERSECT
    SELECT oid
    FROM g_band_no_detections_or_variability
)

-- Step 5: Retrieve all features for the filtered objects
SELECT f.*
FROM feature f
INNER JOIN filtered_objects fo ON f.oid = fo.oid
ORDER BY f.value ASC, f.oid ASC

-- Step 1: Filter objects classified as 'AGN' using the probability table
WITH agn_objects AS (
    SELECT oid
    FROM probability
    WHERE class_name = 'AGN'
      AND ranking = 1
      AND classifier_name = 'lc_classifier'
),

-- Step 2: Identify objects showing variability in the r band (fid = 2)
r_band_variability AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT oid
    FROM feature
    WHERE name = 'Eta_e'
      AND fid = 2
      AND value > 0
),

-- Step 3: Identify objects with no detections or no variability in the g band (fid = 1)
g_band_no_variability AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT oid
    FROM feature
    WHERE name = 'Eta_e'
      AND fid = 1
      AND (value IS NULL OR value <= 0)
),

-- Step 4: Combine the conditions (objects in both r_band_variability and g_band_no_variability)
filtered_objects AS (
    SELECT oid
    FROM r_band_variability
    INTERSECT
    SELECT oid
    FROM g_band_no_variability
),

-- Step 5: Retrieve all features for the filtered objects
features_for_filtered_objects AS (
    SELECT f.*
    FROM feature f
    INNER JOIN filtered_objects fo ON f.oid = fo.oid
)

-- Step 6: Final query to order features by value and then by oid
SELECT *
FROM features_for_filtered_objects
ORDER BY oid, value ASC

    SELECT oid
    FROM magstat
    WHERE fid = 2
      AND magsigma_corr > 0
),

-- Step 3: Sub-query to filter objects with no detections or no variability in the g band
g_band_conditions AS (
    SELECT oid
    FROM magstat
    WHERE fid = 1
      AND (ndet = 0 OR magsigma_corr = 0)
),

-- Step 4: Combine the conditions
filtered_objects AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT agn_objects.oid
    FROM agn_objects
    INNER JOIN r_band_variability ON agn_objects.oid = r_band_variability.oid
    INNER JOIN g_band_conditions ON agn_objects.oid = g_band_conditions.oid
)

-- Step 5: Retrieve features for the filtered objects
SELECT feature.*
FROM feature
INNER JOIN filtered_objects ON feature.oid = filtered_objects.oid
ORDER BY feature.value ASC, feature.oid ASC

-- Step 1: Filter objects classified as AGN with a probability larger than 0.6
WITH probability_filter AS (
    SELECT oid
    FROM probability
    WHERE class_name = 'AGN'
      AND classifier_name = 'lc_classifier'
      AND ranking = 1
      AND probability > 0.6
),

-- Step 2: Filter objects with light curves covering at least one year
object_filter AS (
    SELECT o.oid, o.meanra, o.meandec, o.ndet
    FROM object o
    INNER JOIN probability_filter pf ON o.oid = pf.oid
    WHERE (o.lastmjd - o.firstmjd) >= 365
),

-- Step 3: Filter objects with at least 20 detections in at least one band
detection_filter AS (
    SELECT d.oid, d.fid AS detection_fid, MAX(d.magpsf_corr) AS max_mag, MIN(d.magpsf_corr) AS min_mag,
           (MAX(d.magpsf_corr) - MIN(d.magpsf_corr)) AS delta_mag
    FROM detection d
    INNER JOIN object_filter of ON d.oid = of.oid
    GROUP BY d.oid, d.fid
    HAVING COUNT(d.oid) >= 20
),

-- Step 4: Filter objects with variations in corrected magnitudes
feature_g_filter AS (
    SELECT f.oid, f.name, f.value, f.version, f.fid AS feature_fid
    FROM feature f
    INNER JOIN probability_filter pf ON f.oid = pf.oid
    WHERE f.name = 'delta_mag_fid' AND f.fid = 1 AND f.value > 1
),
feature_r_filter AS (
    SELECT f.oid, f.name, f.value, f.version, f.fid AS feature_fid
    FROM feature f
    INNER JOIN probability_filter pf ON f.oid = pf.oid
    WHERE f.name = 'delta_mag_fid' AND f.fid = 2 AND f.value > 0.5
),
feature_combined AS (
    SELECT oid
    FROM feature_g_filter
    INTERSECT
    SELECT oid
    FROM feature_r_filter
)

-- Step 5: Combine results and retrieve required columns
SELECT of.oid, of.meanra, of.meandec, of.ndet,
       f.name, f.value, f.version, f.feature_fid,
       df.detection_fid, df.max_mag, df.min_mag, df.delta_mag
FROM object_filter of
INNER JOIN detection_filter df ON of.oid = df.oid
INNER JOIN feature_combined fc ON of.oid = fc.oid
INNER JOIN feature f ON fc.oid = f.oid
WHERE f.name IN ('delta_mag_fid')
  AND ((f.fid = 1 AND f.value > 1) OR (f.fid = 2 AND f.value > 0.5))

    FROM object o
    INNER JOIN probability_filter pf ON o.oid = pf.oid
    WHERE (o.lastmjd - o.firstmjd) >= 365
),

feature_n_det AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT f.oid
    FROM feature f
    INNER JOIN object_filter ofil ON f.oid = ofil.oid
    WHERE f.name = 'n_det'
      AND f.value >= 20
),

-- Step 4: Filter objects with variations larger than 1 magnitude in the g band and larger than 0.5 in the r band
feature_delta_mag_g AS (
    SELECT f.oid, f.value AS delta_mag_g, f.name, f.version, f.fid AS feature_fid
    FROM feature f
    INNER JOIN feature_n_det fnd ON f.oid = fnd.oid
    WHERE f.name = 'delta_mag_fid'
      AND f.value > 1
      AND f.fid = 1 -- g band
),
feature_delta_mag_r AS (
    SELECT f.oid, f.value AS delta_mag_r, f.name, f.version, f.fid AS feature_fid
    FROM feature f
    INNER JOIN feature_n_det fnd ON f.oid = fnd.oid
    WHERE f.name = 'delta_mag_fid'
      AND f.value > 0.5
      AND f.fid = 2 -- r band
),

combined_features AS (
    SELECT g.oid, g.delta_mag_g, r.delta_mag_r, g.name AS g_name, r.name AS r_name,
           g.version AS g_version, r.version AS r_version, g.feature_fid AS g_fid, r.feature_fid AS r_fid
    FROM feature_delta_mag_g g
    INNER JOIN feature_delta_mag_r r ON g.oid = r.oid

WITH probability_filter AS (
    SELECT oid
    FROM probability
    WHERE class_name = 'AGN'
      AND classifier_name = 'lc_classifier'
      AND ranking = 1
      AND probability > 0.6
),

-- Step 2: Filter objects with light curves covering at least one year
object_filter AS (
    SELECT o.oid
    FROM object o
    INNER JOIN probability_filter pf ON o.oid = pf.oid
    WHERE (o.lastmjd - o.firstmjd) >= 365
),

-- Step 3: Filter objects with at least 20 detections in at least one band
detections_filter AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT f.oid
    FROM feature f
    INNER JOIN object_filter ofil ON f.oid = ofil.oid
    WHERE f.name = 'n_det'
      AND f.value >= 20
      AND f.fid IN (1, 2) -- g band (1) or r band (2)
),

-- Step 4: Filter objects with variations larger than 1 magnitude in g band and larger than 0.5 in r band
magnitude_variation_filter AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT f1.oid
    FROM feature f1
    INNER JOIN feature f2 ON f1.oid = f2.oid
    INNER JOIN detections_filter df ON f1.oid = df.oid
    WHERE f1.name = 'delta_mag_fid' AND f1.value > 1 AND f1.fid = 1 -- g band
      AND f2.name = 'delta_mag_fid' AND f2.value > 0.5 AND f2.fid = 2 -- r band
),

-- Step 5: Retrieve required columns
final_data AS (
    SELECT o.oid,
           f.name,
           f.value,
           f.version,
           f.fid AS feature_fid,
           o.meanra,
           o.meandec,
           o.ndet,
           MAX(CASE WHEN f.name = 'max_mag' THEN f.value END) AS max_mag,
           MIN(CASE WHEN f.name = 'min_mag' THEN f.value END) AS min_mag,
           (MAX(CASE WHEN f.name = 'max_mag' THEN f.value END) - 
            MIN(CASE WHEN f.name = 'min_mag' THEN f.value END)) AS delta_mag
    FROM object o
    INNER JOIN magnitude_variation_filter mvf ON o.oid = mvf.oid
    INNER JOIN feature f ON o.oid = f.oid
    WHERE f.name IN ('max_mag', 'min_mag')
    GROUP BY o.oid, f.name, f.value, f.version, f.fid, o.meanra, o.meandec, o.ndet
)

-- Step 6: Combine all conditions and retrieve final results
SELECT *
FROM final_data
ORDER BY oid

-- Step 1: Filter objects classified as AGN with a probability > 0.6
WITH probability_filter AS (
    SELECT oid
    FROM probability
    WHERE class_name = 'AGN'
      AND classifier_name = 'lc_classifier'
      AND ranking = 1
      AND probability > 0.6
),

-- Step 2: Filter objects with light curves covering at least one year
object_filter AS (
    SELECT o.oid
    FROM object o
    INNER JOIN probability_filter pf ON o.oid = pf.oid
    WHERE (o.lastmjd - o.firstmjd) >= 365
),

-- Step 3: Filter objects with at least 20 detections in at least one band
feature_n_det_filter AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT f.oid
    FROM feature f
    INNER JOIN object_filter of ON f.oid = of.oid
    WHERE f.name = 'n_det' AND f.value >= 20
),

-- Step 4: Filter objects with variations larger than 1 magnitude in the g band and larger than 0.5 in the r band
feature_delta_mag_g AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT f.oid
    FROM feature f
    INNER JOIN feature_n_det_filter fn ON f.oid = fn.oid
    WHERE f.name = 'delta_mag_fid' AND f.fid = 1 AND f.value > 1
),
feature_delta_mag_r AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT f.oid
    FROM feature f
    INNER JOIN feature_n_det_filter fn ON f.oid = fn.oid
    WHERE f.name = 'delta_mag_fid' AND f.fid = 2 AND f.value > 0.5
),
feature_delta_mag_filter AS (
    SELECT oid
    FROM feature_delta_mag_g
    INTERSECT
    SELECT oid
    FROM feature_delta_mag_r
),

-- Step 5: Calculate maximum and minimum corrected magnitudes for g and r bands
detection_g AS (
    SELECT d.oid, MAX(d.magpsf_corr) AS max_mag_g, MIN(d.magpsf_corr) AS min_mag_g
    FROM detection d
    INNER JOIN feature_delta_mag_filter fdm ON d.oid = fdm.oid
    WHERE d.fid = 1
    GROUP BY d.oid
),
detection_r AS (
    SELECT d.oid, MAX(d.magpsf_corr) AS max_mag_r, MIN(d.magpsf_corr) AS min_mag_r
    FROM detection d
    INNER JOIN feature_delta_mag_filter fdm ON d.oid = fdm.oid
    WHERE d.fid = 2
    GROUP BY d.oid
),

-- Step 6: Combine all conditions and retrieve the final result
final_result AS (
    SELECT 
        o.oid,
        o.meanra,
        o.meandec,
        o.ndet,
        f.name,
        f.value,
        f.version,
        f.fid AS feature_fid,
        dg.max_mag_g,
        dg.min_mag_g,
        (dg.max_mag_g - dg.min_mag_g) AS delta_mag_g,
        dr.max_mag_r,
        dr.min_mag_r,
        (dr.max_mag_r - dr.min_mag_r) AS delta_mag_r
    FROM object o
    INNER JOIN feature_delta_mag_filter fdm ON o.oid = fdm.oid
    INNER JOIN feature f ON o.oid = f.oid
    INNER JOIN detection_g dg ON o.oid = dg.oid
    INNER JOIN detection_r dr ON o.oid = dr.oid
)

-- Final Query
SELECT *
FROM final_result

WITH filtered_probabilities AS (
    SELECT oid
    FROM probability
    WHERE class_name = 'AGN'
      AND classifier_name = 'lc_classifier'
      AND ranking = 1
      AND probability > 0.6
),
filtered_objects AS (
    SELECT o.oid, o.meanra, o.meandec, o.ndet
    FROM object o
    INNER JOIN filtered_probabilities fp ON o.oid = fp.oid
    WHERE (o.lastmjd - o.firstmjd) >= 365
),
filtered_detections AS (
    SELECT d.oid, d.fid AS detection_fid, 
           MAX(d.magpsf_corr) AS max_mag, 
           MIN(d.magpsf_corr) AS min_mag, 
           (MAX(d.magpsf_corr) - MIN(d.magpsf_corr)) AS delta_mag
    FROM detection d
    INNER JOIN filtered_objects fo ON d.oid = fo.oid
    GROUP BY d.oid, d.fid
    HAVING (d.fid = 1 AND (MAX(d.magpsf_corr) - MIN(d.magpsf_corr)) > 1)
       OR (d.fid = 2 AND (MAX(d.magpsf_corr) - MIN(d.magpsf_corr)) > 0.5)
),
valid_objects AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT fd.oid
    FROM filtered_detections fd
    GROUP BY fd.oid
    HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT fd.detection_fid) >= 2
),
features_data AS (
    SELECT f.oid, f.name, f.value, f.version, f.fid AS feature_fid
    FROM feature f
    INNER JOIN valid_objects vo ON f.oid = vo.oid
)
SELECT fo.oid, 
       fd.detection_fid, 
       fd.max_mag, 
       fd.min_mag, 
       fd.delta_mag, 
       f.name, 
       f.value, 
       f.version, 
       f.feature_fid, 
       fo.meanra, 
       fo.meandec, 
       fo.ndet
FROM filtered_objects fo
INNER JOIN filtered_detections fd ON fo.oid = fd.oid
INNER JOIN features_data f ON fo.oid = f.oid

-- Step 1: Filter objects based on the stamp classifier and class 'SN'
WITH stamp_classifier_sn AS (
    SELECT 
        oid, 
        probability
    FROM 
        probability
    WHERE 
        classifier_name = 'stamp_classifier' 
        AND class_name = 'SN' 
        AND ranking = 1
),

-- Step 2: Filter objects with their first detection in the first two days of September
first_detection_september AS (
    SELECT 
        oid
    FROM 
        object
    WHERE 
        firstmjd >= 60188.0 
        AND firstmjd < 60190.0
),

-- Step 3: Identify objects that qualify as fast risers
fast_risers AS (
    SELECT 
        d.oid
    FROM 
        detection d
    INNER JOIN (
        SELECT 
            oid, 
            fid, 
            MIN(mjd) AS first_detection_mjd
        FROM 
            detection
        GROUP BY 
            oid, fid
    ) first_det ON d.oid = first_det.oid AND d.fid = first_det.fid AND d.mjd = first_det.first_detection_mjd
    INNER JOIN (
        SELECT 
            oid, 
            fid, 
            MAX(mjd) AS last_non_detection_mjd, 
            diffmaglim
        FROM 
            non_detection
        GROUP BY 
            oid, fid, diffmaglim
    ) last_non_det ON d.oid = last_non_det.oid AND d.fid = last_non_det.fid AND last_non_det.last_non_detection_mjd < first_det.first_detection_mjd
    WHERE 
        (last_non_det.diffmaglim - d.magpsf) / (first_det.first_detection_mjd - last_non_det.last_non_detection_mjd) >= 0.25
),

-- Step 4: Combine filters from Steps 1, 2, and 3
filtered_objects AS (
    SELECT 
        sc.oid, 
        sc.probability
    FROM 
        stamp_classifier_sn sc
    INNER JOIN 
        first_detection_september fd ON sc.oid = fd.oid
    INNER JOIN 
        fast_risers fr ON sc.oid = fr.oid
),

-- Step 5: Retrieve light curves (detections and non-detections)
light_curves AS (
    SELECT 
        oid, 
        mjd, 
        fid, 
        NULL AS magpsf, 
        NULL AS sigmapsf, 
        diffmaglim
    FROM 
        non_detection
    WHERE 
        oid IN (SELECT oid FROM filtered_objects)
),

-- Step 6: Retrieve additional information from the magstat table
magstat_info AS (
    SELECT 
        oid, 
        fid AS magstat_fid, 
        dmdt_first
    FROM 
        magstat
    WHERE 
        oid IN (SELECT oid FROM filtered_objects)
)

-- Step 7: Combine all required information
SELECT 
    fo.oid, 
    fo.probability, 
    lc.mjd, 
    lc.fid, 
    lc.diffmaglim, 
    mi.magstat_fid, 
    mi.dmdt_first
FROM 
    filtered_objects fo
LEFT JOIN 
    light_curves lc ON fo.oid = lc.oid
LEFT JOIN 
    magstat_info mi ON fo.oid = mi.oid
ORDER BY 
    fo.oid
LIMIT 100

WITH stamp_classifier_sn AS (
    -- Step 1: Filter objects based on the stamp_classifier highest probability for class 'SN'
    SELECT 
        p.oid, 
        p.probability
    FROM 
        probability p
    WHERE 
        p.classifier_name = 'stamp_classifier' 
        AND p.class_name = 'SN' 
        AND p.ranking = 1
),
first_detection_september AS (
    -- Step 2: Filter objects with their first detection in the first two days of September
    SELECT 
        o.oid, 
        o.firstmjd
    FROM 
        object o
    WHERE 
        o.firstmjd >= 60188.0 
        AND o.firstmjd < 60190.0
),
fast_risers AS (
    -- Step 3: Identify objects that qualify as fast risers
    SELECT 
        d.oid,
        (nd.diffmaglim - d.magpsf) / (d.mjd - nd.mjd) AS initial_rise
    FROM 
        detection d
    INNER JOIN 
        non_detection nd 
        ON d.oid = nd.oid AND d.fid = nd.fid
    WHERE 
        nd.mjd = (
            SELECT MAX(nd2.mjd)
            FROM non_detection nd2
            WHERE nd2.oid = d.oid AND nd2.fid = d.fid AND nd2.mjd < d.mjd
        )
        AND d.mjd = (
            SELECT MIN(d2.mjd)
            FROM detection d2
            WHERE d2.oid = d.oid
        )
        AND (nd.diffmaglim - d.magpsf) / (d.mjd - nd.mjd) >= 0.25
),
filtered_objects AS (
    -- Step 4: Combine the filters from Steps 1, 2, and 3
    SELECT 
        sc.oid, 
        sc.probability, 
        fr.initial_rise
    FROM 
        stamp_classifier_sn sc
    INNER JOIN 
        first_detection_september fd 
        ON sc.oid = fd.oid
    INNER JOIN 
        fast_risers fr 
        ON sc.oid = fr.oid
),
light_curves AS (
    -- Step 5: Retrieve light curves (detections and non-detections) for the filtered objects
    SELECT 
        d.oid, 
        d.mjd, 
        d.fid, 
        d.magpsf, 
        d.diffmaglim
    FROM 
        detection d
    WHERE 
        d.oid IN (SELECT oid FROM filtered_objects)
    UNION
    SELECT 
        nd.oid, 
        nd.mjd, 
        nd.fid, 
        NULL AS magpsf, 
        nd.diffmaglim
    FROM 
        non_detection nd
    WHERE 
        nd.oid IN (SELECT oid FROM filtered_objects)
),
magstat_data AS (
    -- Step 6: Retrieve additional information from the magstat table
    SELECT 
        m.oid, 
        m.fid AS magstat_fid
    FROM 
        magstat m
    WHERE 
        m.oid IN (SELECT oid FROM filtered_objects)
)
-- Step 7: Combine all required information
SELECT 
    fo.oid, 
    fo.probability, 
    lc.mjd, 
    lc.fid, 
    lc.magpsf, 
    lc.diffmaglim, 
    ms.magstat_fid, 
    fo.initial_rise
FROM 
    filtered_objects fo
INNER JOIN 
    light_curves lc 
    ON fo.oid = lc.oid
LEFT JOIN 
    magstat_data ms 
    ON fo.oid = ms.oid
ORDER BY 
    fo.oid
LIMIT 100

        AND p.ranking = 1
),

    -- Step 3: Filter objects detected in the first two days of September
    SELECT 
        o.oid, 
        o.firstmjd
    FROM 
        object o
    INNER JOIN 
        filtered_probabilities fp ON o.oid = fp.oid
    WHERE 
        o.firstmjd BETWEEN 60188.0 AND 60189.0
),
last_non_detections AS (
    -- Step 4.1: Find the last non-detection before the first detection
    SELECT 
        nd.oid, 
        nd.fid, 
        MAX(nd.mjd) AS last_non_detection_mjd, 
        nd.diffmaglim
    FROM 
        non_detection nd
    INNER JOIN 
        filtered_objects fo ON nd.oid = fo.oid
    WHERE 
        nd.mjd < fo.firstmjd
    GROUP BY 
        nd.oid, nd.fid, nd.diffmaglim
),
first_detections AS (
    -- Step 4.2: Find the first detection
    SELECT 
        d.oid, 
        d.fid, 
        d.mjd AS first_detection_mjd, 
        d.magpsf
    FROM 
        detection d
    INNER JOIN 
        filtered_objects fo ON d.oid = fo.oid
    WHERE 
        d.mjd = fo.firstmjd
),
fast_risers AS (
    -- Step 4.3: Calculate the magnitude rise rate and filter fast risers
    SELECT 
        lnd.oid, 
        lnd.fid, 
        lnd.last_non_detection_mjd, 
        lnd.diffmaglim, 
        fd.first_detection_mjd, 
        fd.magpsf,
        (lnd.diffmaglim - fd.magpsf) / (fd.first_detection_mjd - lnd.last_non_detection_mjd) AS rate
    FROM 
        last_non_detections lnd
    INNER JOIN 
        first_detections fd ON lnd.oid = fd.oid AND lnd.fid = fd.fid
    WHERE 
        (lnd.diffmaglim - fd.magpsf) / (fd.first_detection_mjd - lnd.last_non_detection_mjd) >= 0.25
),

    -- Step 5: Retrieve light curves (non-detections only)
    SELECT 
        nd.oid, 
        nd.fid, 
        nd.mjd, 
        nd.diffmaglim
    FROM 
        non_detection nd
    INNER JOIN 
        fast_risers fr ON nd.oid = fr.oid
),

    -- Step 6: Retrieve additional information from the magstat table

        ms.oid, 
        ms.fid AS magstat_fid

        magstat ms

        fast_risers fr ON ms.oid = fr.oid

FROM

    light_curves lc ON fr.oid = lc.oid

    magstat_info mi ON fr.oid = mi.oid

    fr.oid

    SELECT 
        d.oid, 
        d.fid, 
        d.mjd AS firstmjd, 
        d.magpsf, 
        nd.mjd AS last_non_detection_mjd, 
        nd.diffmaglim, 
        (nd.diffmaglim - d.magpsf) / (d.mjd - nd.mjd) AS rise_rate
    FROM 
        detection d
    INNER JOIN 
        non_detection nd 
    ON 
        d.oid = nd.oid 
        AND d.fid = nd.fid 
        AND nd.mjd < d.mjd
    WHERE 
        (d.mjd - nd.mjd) > 0 
        AND (nd.diffmaglim - d.magpsf) / (d.mjd - nd.mjd) >= 0.25
),

    -- Step 4: Combine filters to identify the final set of objects
    SELECT 
        sc.oid, 
        sc.probability, 
        fr.fid, 
        fr.firstmjd, 
        fr.magpsf, 
        fr.last_non_detection_mjd, 
        fr.diffmaglim, 
        fr.rise_rate
    FROM 
        stamp_classifier_sn sc
    INNER JOIN 
        first_detection_september fd 
    ON 
        sc.oid = fd.oid
    INNER JOIN 
        fast_risers fr 
    ON 
        sc.oid = fr.oid
),

    -- Step 5: Retrieve light curves (detections and non-detections) for the selected objects
    SELECT 
        oid, 
        mjd, 
        fid, 
        NULL AS magpsf,

    firstmjd

    ztf_objects

WITH filtered_ps1 AS (
    -- Step 1: Filter objects based on the distance to the nearest PS1 source
    SELECT oid
    FROM ps1_ztf
    WHERE distpsnr1 > 5
),
filtered_probabilities AS (
    -- Step 2: Filter objects based on classification probability
    SELECT oid
    FROM probability
    WHERE ranking = 1
      AND classifier_name = 'lc_classifier'
      AND probability > 0.7
      AND class_name NOT IN ('SNIa', 'SNIbc', 'SNII', 'SLSN')
),
filtered_objects AS (
    -- Step 3: Combine the filtered results from Step 1 and Step 2
    SELECT oid
    FROM filtered_ps1
    INTERSECT
    SELECT oid
    FROM filtered_probabilities
)
-- Step 4: Retrieve all columns from the 'object', 'probability', and 'ps1_ztf' tables
SELECT *
FROM object
INNER JOIN probability ON object.oid = probability.oid
INNER JOIN ps1_ztf ON object.oid = ps1_ztf.oid
WHERE object.oid IN (SELECT oid FROM filtered_objects)
  AND probability.ranking = 1
  AND probability.classifier_name = 'lc_classifier'
-- Step 5: Order the results by the nearest PS1 source distance and limit to 200 objects
ORDER BY ps1_ztf.distpsnr1 ASC

-- Query to retrieve ALLWISE objects within a 1 arcsec radius from the specified coordinates
-- and return the requested data.

SELECT 
    oid_catalog AS identifier, 
    ra, 
    dec, 
    w1mpro AS w1_magnitude, 
    w1sigmpro AS w1_uncertainty, 
    w2mpro AS w2_magnitude, 
    w2sigmpro AS w2_uncertainty, 
    j_m_2mass AS j_magnitude, 
    j_msig_2mass AS j_uncertainty
FROM 
    allwise
WHERE 
    q3c_radial_query(ra, dec, 23.6488, 30.7314, 1/3600.0) -- 1 arcsec radius converted to degrees

sql_query:
-- Step 1: Filter the probability table for objects classified as 'asteroid' with probability > 0.9
-- Step 2: Join with ss_ztf to get Solar System object information
-- Step 3: Join with detection to get candidate-related information
-- Step 4: Limit the results to 30 rows

SELECT 
    p.oid AS ztf_object_id, 
    d.candid AS candidate_id, 
    s.ssdistnr AS distance_to_nearest_solar_system_object, 
    s.ssmagnr AS mpc_archive_magnitude, 
    s.ssnamenr AS nearest_solar_system_object_name, 
    d.fid AS filter_identifier, 
    d.fwhm AS fwhm_from_sextractor, 
    d.ncalib AS number_of_ps1_calibrators_used, 
    d.exptime AS exposure_time
FROM 
    (SELECT oid 
     FROM probability 
     WHERE class_name = 'asteroid' 
       AND classifier_name = 'stamp_classifier' 
       AND classifier_version = 'stamp_classifier_1.0.4' 
       AND probability > 0.9 
       AND ranking = 1) p
INNER JOIN ss_ztf s ON p.oid = s.oid
INNER JOIN detection d ON p.oid = d.oid
LIMIT 30

WITH filtered_objects AS (
    -- Step 1: Filter objects with more than 500 detections
    SELECT oid, ndet, firstmjd, lastmjd
    FROM object
    WHERE ndet > 500
),
filtered_probabilities AS (
    -- Step 2: Filter probabilities for 'asteroid' class in 'stamp_classifier' with probability > 0.5
    SELECT oid, probability
    FROM probability
    WHERE class_name = 'asteroid'
      AND classifier_name = 'stamp_classifier'
      AND classifier_version = 'stamp_classifier_1.0.4'
      AND probability > 0.5
      AND ranking = 1
),
filtered_ss_objects AS (
    -- Step 3: Filter Solar System objects with distance < 2 arcsec
    SELECT oid, candid, ssdistnr, ssnamenr
    FROM ss_ztf
    WHERE ssdistnr < 2
),
joined_data AS (
    -- Step 4: Join the filtered results
    SELECT 
        o.oid,
        o.ndet,
        o.firstmjd,
        o.lastmjd,
        p.probability,
        ss.candid,
        ss.ssdistnr,
        ss.ssnamenr
    FROM filtered_objects o
    INNER JOIN filtered_probabilities p ON o.oid = p.oid
    INNER JOIN filtered_ss_objects ss ON o.oid = ss.oid
),
detection_details AS (
    -- Step 5: Retrieve detection details
    SELECT 
        jd.oid,
        jd.ndet,
        jd.firstmjd,
        jd.lastmjd,
        jd.probability,
        jd.candid,
        jd.ssdistnr,
        jd.ssnamenr,
        d.mjd AS detection_date,
        d.fid AS filter_id
    FROM joined_data jd
    INNER JOIN detection d ON jd.oid = d.oid AND jd.candid = d.candid
)
-- Step 6: Select and order the final result
SELECT 
    oid AS ztf_identifier,
    ndet AS number_of_detections,
    firstmjd AS first_detection_date,
    lastmjd AS last_detection_date,
    probability,
    candid AS candidate_identifier,
    ssdistnr AS distance_to_mpc_object,
    ssnamenr AS mpc_name,
    detection_date,
    filter_id
FROM detection_details
ORDER BY first_detection_date ASC
LIMIT 10

    AND p.probability > 0.5
    AND p.ranking = 1
    AND s.ssdistnr < 2

Beyond1Std: Percentage of points with photometric mag that lie beyond 1 sigma from the mean
Con: Number of three consecutive data points brighter/fainter than 2 sigma of the light curve
delta_mag_fid: Difference between maximum and minimum observed magnitude in a given band
delta_mjd_fid: Total timespan of the light curve in a given band
delta_period: Absolute value of the difference between the Multiband_period and the MHAOV period obtained using a single band

ExcessVar: Measure of the intrinsic variability amplitude [(Std - average photometric error)/Mean]
first_mag: magnitude of the first alert in a given band

gal_b: Galactic latitude

Harmonics_mag_7: Amplitude of the 7th component of the harmonics series (obtained by fitting a harmonic series up to the seventh harmonic)
Harmonics_mse: Mean squarre error of the harmonics series (obtained by fitting a harmonic series up to the seventh harmonic)
Harmonics_phase_2: Phase of the 2nd component of the harmonics series (obtained by fitting a harmonic series up to the seventh harmonic)

LinearTrend: Slope of a linear fit to the light curve

Mean: Mean lc_corr magnitude (or mean lc_diff if the source cannot be corrected)
Meanvariance: Ratio of the standard deviation to the mean magnitude
median_diffmaglim_after_fid: Median non-detection diffmaglim in the ''x'' band after the first detection in any band
median_diffmaglim_before_fid: Median non-detection diffmaglim in the ''x'' band before the first detection in any band
MedianAbsDev: Median discrepancy of the data from the median data

MHPS_ratio: Ratio between the MHPS_low and MHPS_high variances for a given band
min_mag: minimun magnitude of the alert light curve in a given band

Pvar: Probability that the source is intrinsically variable

-- Query to find at most 30 ZTF objects satisfying the given conditions
SELECT 
    o.oid,  -- ZTF identifier
    o.ndet,  -- Number of detections
    o.firstmjd,  -- First detection date
    p1.probability AS prob_stamp_bogus,  -- Probability in the stamp classifier for 'bogus'
    p2.probability AS prob_lc_transient  -- Probability in the light curve classifier top level for 'Transient'
FROM 
    object o
INNER JOIN 
    probability p1
    ON o.oid = p1.oid
    AND p1.class_name = 'bogus'
    AND p1.classifier_name = 'stamp_classifier'
    AND p1.classifier_version = 'stamp_classifier_1.0.4'
    AND p1.probability > 0.7
INNER JOIN 
    probability p2
    ON o.oid = p2.oid
    AND p2.class_name = 'Transient'
    AND p2.classifier_name = 'lc_classifier_top'
    AND p2.probability > 0.9
WHERE 
    o.ndet > 10
ORDER BY 
    p1.oid  -- Order by the ZTF identifier of objects classified as 'bogus' in the stamp classifier
LIMIT 30  -- Limit the results to at most 30 rows

    det.ra, 
    det.dec,

    (MAX(det.magpsf_corr) - MIN(det.magpsf_corr)) AS max_rise_from_min

    object obj

    probability prob ON obj.oid = prob.oid
